question: What proportion of single bonds are carcinogenic? Please provide your answer as a percentage with five decimal places.
evidence: single bond refers to bond_type = '-'; label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; proportion = DIVIDE(SUM(label = '+') * 100, COUNT(bond_id)) where bond_type = '-'
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching molecule record.
gold: SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN T1.bond_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.bond_id), 5) FROM bond AS T1 LEFT JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '-'
gold0: SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN T1.bond_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.bond_id),5) FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '-'

c.request:
What proportion of single bonds are carcinogenic? Please provide your answer as a percentage with five decimal places.
Evidence: single bond refers to bond_type = '-'; label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; proportion = DIVIDE(SUM(label = '+') * 100, COUNT(bond_id)) where bond_type = '-'
Also keep rows that have no matching molecule record.
c.sql: SELECT printf('%.5f', 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(b.bond_id), 0)) AS percentage FROM bond AS b LEFT JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

d.request: What percentage of single bonds (bond_type = '-') are associated with carcinogenic molecules (label = '+')? Include bonds with no matching molecule record in the total and give the percentage to five decimal places.
d.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 5) AS percentage FROM bond AS b LEFT JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

b.request: Among all bonds with `bond_type = '-'`, including those with no matching molecule record, what percentage belong to molecules with `label = '+'`? Report five decimal places
b.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE printf('%.5f', 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)) END AS percentage FROM bond AS b LEFT JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
